name: script_vm
doc: The field script VM's opcodes, their kinds and constants (D-36 package 2, step A). tools/vm_ext.py script-header writes include/capsule/script/ops.h from it; tools/script_compiler.py reads it. Ids and value orders are the bytecode: never renumber. Ops with a "handler" belong to an engine module ("module") and run through the game's dispatch table (step B): `script_vm.py dispatch` writes it, with only the ops the game's scripts use; "polls" names the module waits and the ops that set them.

ops.name: End
ops.doc: End the script.
ops.does: ends the script (and every caller)

ops.name: Return
ops.doc: Return to the caller.
ops.does: returns to the caller, or ends at the outermost level

ops.name: Goto

ops.does: jumps

ops.name: BoxWithdraw

ops.name: BoxesOpen

ops.name: Transform

ops.name: FieldEffect
ops.doc: Start or read a timed field effect (F1, D-27 section 2).
ops.does: a timed field effect (capsule/script/field_effects.h; F1): Start starts it by its stack rule (var = 1 started, 0 refused), Active (var = 1 while it runs), Remaining (var = its steps or minutes left)

ops.name: Darkness
ops.doc: Set the shown map's darkness level (F2, D-27 section 3).
ops.does: the shown map's darkness level, 0 (lit) to map::kMaxDarkness, until the next map (world::set_darkness(); F2)

ops.name: Flight
ops.doc: Record, visit or pick a flight point (F2).
ops.does: a flight point (capsule/script/field_actions.h): Record sets its flag, Visit warps there (waits), Menu lists the recorded points and warps to the one picked (waits; var = 1 warped, 0 backed out)

ops.name: Escape
ops.doc: Warp to the escape point (F2).
ops.does: warps to the escape point when one is recorded (world::escape(); waits); var = 1 when it warped

ops.name: FieldAction
ops.doc: Ask whether a field action is available (F2).
ops.does: Available: var = the first party member the action's requirement holds for, plus 1 (0: none; actions::available())

ops.name: ObjectMoveChecked
ops.doc: Walk a map object or the player by the movement rules, or not at all (C8).
ops.does: C8: as ObjectMove when every step of the walk is allowed by the field's movement rules (world::path_clear(): terrain, elevation, vehicle class, objects); else nothing moves; var = 1 when it walks (waits until it stands), 0 when blocked

ops.name: Combine
ops.doc: Run or ask a combination method (B1).
ops.bytes: kind8 (CombineOp), method8, [Run / Preview / Status / Fee: count8, count operands (party slots)], var16
ops.does: B1: a combination method (capsule/script/combine_port.h): Open picks the inputs through the menu, previews, asks and combines, Run combines the given members (both wait; var = 0 backed out, 1 combined, 2 refused); Preview: var = the result species + 1 (0: none, kCombineRandom: a random pick), Status: the combine::Status, Fee: the fee

ops.name: Nursery
ops.doc: The nursery: deposit, withdraw, queries, the result, the nickname prompt (B2).
ops.bytes: kind8 (NurseryOp), [Deposit / Withdraw / Levels / Fee / Name: operand], [Withdraw: var16 money (or kNoVar)], var16
ops.does: B2: the nursery (capsule/script/nursery_port.h): Pick opens the party menu (waits; var = member + 1, 0 backed out), Deposit (var = 1 when it went), Withdraw with the fee taken from the money variable (var = 1 done, 0 refused, kNurseryPoor too poor), Count, Levels (gained), Fee, Ready (var = 1 when a result waits), Odds, Take (var = 1 when it joined the party), Name (the nickname prompt; waits; var = 1 named)

ops.name: Jump
ops.doc: Go on in another script (the frame is replaced).
ops.does: I4: goes on in another script in the same frame (nothing returns here; a `goto` naming a script)
ops.comment: I4 (D-29): what imported event scripts need

ops.name: Lock
ops.doc: Stop the objects' own movement.
ops.does: I4: stops / lets go the objects' own movement (world::lock() / release())

ops.name: Release
ops.doc: Let them move again.
ops.does: I4: stops / lets go the objects' own movement (world::lock() / release())

ops.name: MessageEx
ops.doc: A message typed at once, scrolling on, or not waited for.
ops.does: I4: as Message, typed at once (kMessageInstant), scrolling on by itself (kMessageAutoScroll), or without waiting for the typing (kMessageNoWait)

ops.name: WaitMessage
ops.doc: Wait until the message is typed.
ops.does: I4: waits until the message is typed

ops.name: WaitObject
ops.doc: Wait until one object stands.
ops.does: I4: waits until that object (or the walker) stands

ops.name: ObjectRemove
ops.doc: Remove a map object until its flag clears.
ops.does: I4: removes a map object for good on this map (world::remove(): hidden, its hide flag set)

ops.name: ObjectVisible
ops.doc: Show or hide an object's sprite where it stands.
ops.does: I4: shows or hides its sprite where it stands (it still blocks)

ops.name: ObjectTemplate
ops.doc: Change an object's template on the shown map.
ops.bytes: operand (object), kind8 (TemplateOp), [Pos: operand x, operand y], [Movement: operand]
ops.does: I4: changes the object's template on the shown map until the next map (world::set_template())

ops.name: Door

ops.bytes: kind8 (DoorOp), [all but Wait: operand x, operand y]
ops.does: I4: a door's animation on a cell (world::door()); Wait waits until it ends

ops.name: Weather
ops.doc: Set, reset or apply the weather.
ops.does: I4: the weather the next Apply shows (world::weather())

ops.name: Fade
ops.doc: Fade the screen.
ops.does: I4: fades the screen (world::fade()); waits

ops.name: SetMetatile
ops.doc: Change a cell of the shown map.
ops.bytes: operand x, operand y, operand (metatile), operand (solid)
ops.does: I4: changes a cell of the shown map until the next map (world::set_metatile())

ops.name: Respawn

ops.does: I4: remembers a warp destination (world::set_warp())

ops.name: Sound

ops.name: Mart

ops.name: CallLoose
ops.doc: A call that becomes a jump on a full stack.

ops.name: WaitState
ops.doc: Wait while the game is busy.
ops.does: I4: waits while the game is busy (game::state_busy(): a special the game runs over frames)

ops.name: Override
ops.doc: DS1: apply or clear a cell override set.
ops.does: DS1: a cell override set of the world (index into map::kWorld.override_sets; world::override_set())

ops.name: Encounter
ops.doc: The encounter record: its sides (parties), texts, beaten flags and where the script goes on (D-36 package 2 C1).
ops.bytes: kind8 (EncounterOp), then by kind: Set: side8, operand (party), operand (object), flag16 (or kEncounterNoFlag), parts8 (kEncounterHas... bits), the texts and script16s (after, then) the bits name, bits8 (kEncounter... mode bits), mode8 (the game's own number); Select: operand (side); Get: field8 (EncounterField), var16; Text: which8 (kEncounterHasIntro / Defeat / Cannot), flags8 (kMessage... bits, as MessageEx); Next: var16 (or kNoVar); Clear / Music / Mark / Continue / After / Load / Approach: nothing
ops.does: C1: Clear empties the record; Set fills a side, remembers the instruction after it as the return point and, with a then-script, goes on there; Select picks the current side; Get reads the record into a variable; Text types the current side's text (waits until typed unless kMessageNoWait); Music plays the current party's encounter music (battle port); Mark sets the filled sides' beaten flags; Continue goes on at the return point (else ends); After goes on in the current side's after-script (without one, the next instruction); C1b: Load fills the sides from the field's spotter group (each spotter's script runs to its first Set); Approach walks the current side's object up to the walker (world::approach()) and waits; Next makes the next filled side current (var = 1), after the last side A (var = 0)

ops.name: Battle
ops.doc: Start a battle through the game's battle port and wait for its outcome (D-36 package 2 C1).
ops.bytes: kind8 (BattleKind), [Unowned: operand species, operand level, operand item], [Scripted: operand number], var16 (or kNoVar)
ops.does: C1: the battle (capsule/script/battle_port.h; Party / Rematch take the encounter record's sides); waits until it ends; var = its capsule::battle::Outcome

ops.name: Prop
ops.doc: C2: place, turn or remove a prop (a sprite standing on a cell, no object).
ops.bytes: kind8 (PropOp), id8, [Place: sprite32 (asset key), operand x, operand y, elevation8, facing8], [Face: facing8]
ops.does: C2: world::place_prop() / face_prop() / remove_prop() (capsule/field/field.h props; gone at the next map)

ops.name: ObjectOrder
ops.doc: C2: fix an object's draw order among the sprites, or give it back to the world's rule.
ops.bytes: operand (object), fixed8 (1 fixed, 0 the world's rule), order8
ops.does: C2: world::set_order() (field::set_fixed_order(); the walker as player)

ops.name: Menu
ops.doc: C3: a positioned menu of a list asset's texts (a column, a grid or a scrolling list).
ops.bytes: var16, flags8 (kMenu... bits), x8, y8, cursor8, columns8, rows8, delay8 (kMenuStyleDelay: the port's), cancel8, list32 (asset key), style32 (text box asset key, or 0)
ops.does: C3: port::menu_open() / menu_poll(); waits until it answers; var = the chosen option's index, or cancel (Back with kMenuBack; a menu that cannot open)

ops.name: Name
ops.doc: C4: write a name slot (a name placeholder: STR_VAR-like text buffers) from a text, a list entry, a number or a name of a kind.
ops.bytes: slot8 (the name placeholder's index), source8 (NameSource), [Text: text ref], [Entry: list32 (asset key), operand index], [Number: operand], [Kind: kind8 (NameKind, or kFirstGameNameKind + the manifest's name_kinds index), operand id, counted8 (1: an operand count follows), [operand count]]
ops.does: C4: script::set_name() of the source's text, cut to the slot's length (a kind: game::name_text(); the engine's kinds' defaults from the battle data and the party)

ops.name: Counter
ops.doc: C5: show, update or hide a counter box (a variable's value beside the messages: money, coins).
ops.bytes: kind8 (CounterOp), box8 (the manifest's counters index), var16 (its variable), [Show: x8, y8 (cells), label text ref]
ops.does: C5: world::counter() with the variable's current value (the default: the text layer's banner)

ops.name: Stat
ops.doc: C6: add to a game statistic the game's port holds (a stat bound to a variable compiles to AddVar instead).
ops.bytes: stat8 (the manifest's stats index), operand (the amount)
ops.does: C6: world::add_stat() (the default does nothing: only a manifest with stats_port emits the op)

ops.name: Party
ops.doc: C7: heal, stash or restore the party, count its members, or find one knowing a move; C8: give a creature or an egg.; C13: the lead's slot, count the living members, ask about a type.
ops.bytes: kind8 (PartyOp), [Count: hatched8, var16], [Find: var16 (slot), var16 (species, or kNoVar), operand (move)], [Give: var16, operand (species), operand (level), operand (item)], [GiveEgg: var16, operand (species)], [Lead: var16], [CountAlive: var16, operand (slot left out, or kNoMember)], [HasType: var16, operand (type)]
ops.does: C7: party::heal() / stash() / restore(); var = party::count(); slot var = party::find_move() (the party's size when none), species var = its species; C8: var = party::give() / give_egg() (kGivenParty, kGivenBoxes, kGivenNone); C13: var = party::lead() / count_alive() / has_type()

ops.name: ItemQuery
ops.doc: C7: whether the bag takes more of an item, or an item's pocket.
ops.does: C7: var = items::room() (1 when the bag takes n more) or items::pocket()

ops.name: MapView
ops.doc: C9: redraw the shown view, or show the shown map with another map's terrain; C12: show the map's name banner.
ops.does: C9: world::redraw_map() / world::set_layout(); C12: world::show_map_banner()

ops.name: Animation
ops.doc: C9: set a visual field animation's argument, start one, or wait for its end.
ops.does: C9: world::animation_arg() / animation_start(); Wait waits while world::animation_done() is false

ops.name: Camera

ops.does: C9: world::camera_detach() / camera_attach() / camera_shake()

ops.name: DarknessFade
ops.doc: C9: change the shown map's darkness level gradually and wait for it.
ops.does: C9: world::fade_darkness(); waits while world::darkness_fading()

ops.name: BattleSetup
ops.doc: C10: prepare an opponent a later battle fights, read the last outcome, or ask about the current side's rematch.
ops.bytes: kind8 (BattleSetupOp), [Prepare: operand (species), operand (level), operand (item)], [Outcome, RematchDue, RematchReady: var16]
ops.does: C10: battles::prepare(); var = battles::outcome_code() / rematch_due() / rematch_ready()

ops.name: Picture
ops.doc: C12: show a creature's picture in a framed window, or hide it and wait for it to close.
ops.does: C12: world::picture_show(); Hide: world::picture_hide(), waits while world::picture_busy()

ops.name: Screen
ops.doc: C12: open one of the game's screens and wait until the field is back.
ops.does: C12: world::open_screen(); waits while world::screen_busy()

ops.name: Member
ops.doc: C13: read one party member's data: its species, whether it is an egg, how many moves it knows, its friendship.
ops.does: C13: var = party::member_field()

values.name: OnFrame
values.doc: While its condition holds; re-checked only after a flag or variable it reads changes.

values.name: OnResume
values.doc: I4: once when the field resumes on the map (after on_load; must not wait).

values.name: OnWarpInto
values.doc: I4: after a warp's arrival, the first entry whose condition holds (must not wait).

values.name: OnDive
values.doc: I4: when a dive or emerge leads to the map (must not wait).

values.name: OnReturn
values.doc: I4: when the field comes back from a menu or a battle (must not wait).

values.name: Start
values.doc: Start it (amount operand); var = 1 started, 0 refused.

values.name: Active
values.doc: var = 1 while it runs.

values.name: Remaining
values.doc: var = what it has left.

values.name: Record
values.doc: Record a point (its flag).

values.name: Visit
values.doc: Warp to a point (transition operand).

values.name: Menu
values.doc: The menu of recorded points: warp to the one picked; var = 1 warped, 0 backed out.

values.name: Available
values.doc: var = the first member it is available to, plus 1; 0 when none (or no party).

values.name: Open
values.doc: The menu flow: pick the inputs, preview, ask, combine (waits).

values.name: Run
values.doc: Combine the given party members (waits: the move picks).

values.name: Preview
values.doc: var = the result species + 1 (0: it does not combine; kCombineRandom: a random pick).

values.name: Status
values.doc: var = what a combination would say (capsule::combine::Status).

values.name: Fee
values.doc: var = its fee (0 when it does not combine or the result is a random pick).

values.name: Pick
values.doc: The party menu (waits): var = the member + 1, 0 backed out.

values.name: Deposit
values.doc: Leave a party member (operand): var = 1 when it went.

values.name: Withdraw
values.doc:
Take a slot's record back (operand) paying its fee from a money variable: var = 1 done, 0 refused,
kNurseryPoor not enough money.

values.name: Count
values.doc: var = the records held.

values.name: Levels
values.doc: var = the levels a slot's record gained (operand).

values.name: Fee
values.doc: var = what taking a slot's record back costs (operand).

values.name: Ready
values.doc: var = 1 when a result waits.

values.name: Odds
values.doc: var = the method's odds over the held records.

values.name: Take
values.doc: The waiting result joins the party: var = 1 when it did.

values.name: Name
values.doc: The nickname prompt for a party member (operand; waits): var = 1 when named.

values.name: Clear
values.doc: Empty the record (both sides, the mode bits, the return point).

values.name: Set
values.doc: Fill a side: party, object, beaten flag, texts, after-script, mode bits, the game's mode number; the return point; then go on in its then-script.

values.name: Select
values.doc: The current side (operand: kEncounterSideA / B / C).

values.name: Get
values.doc: var = a field of the record (EncounterField).

values.name: Text
values.doc: Type one of the current side's texts (waits until typed unless kMessageNoWait).

values.name: Music
values.doc: The current party's encounter music (none with kEncounterNoMusic).

values.name: Mark
values.doc: Set the filled sides' beaten flags.

values.name: Continue
values.doc: Go on at the return point (end the script without one).

values.name: After
values.doc: Go on in the current side's after-script (without one, the next statement runs).

values.name: Load
values.doc: C1b: empty the record and fill sides A, B, C from the field's spotter group (world::spotters()): each spotter's script runs, its object the spotter, until its first Set, which fills that spotter's side without its then-script.

values.name: Approach
values.doc: C1b: the current side's object walks up to the walker (world::approach()); waits until it stands.

values.name: Next
values.doc: C1b: the next filled side becomes current (var = 1); after the last, side A (var = 0).

values.name: Party
values.doc: The current side's party (the game's number).

values.name: Object
values.doc: The current side's map object (local ID, kNoSelf without one).

values.name: Beaten
values.doc: 1 when the current side's beaten flag is set.

values.name: Bits
values.doc: The mode bits (kEncounterPair / Rematch / NoMusic).

values.name: Side
values.doc: The current side (0 A, 1 B).

values.name: Sides
values.doc: How many sides are filled.

values.name: Mode
values.doc: The game's mode number (the last Set's `mode`).

values.name: Place
values.doc: Place it (the same id again replaces it).

values.name: Face
values.doc: Turn it.

values.name: Remove
values.doc: Remove it.

enums.name: BattleKind
doc: Battle op kinds (C1; capsule/script/battle_port.h; tools/script_compiler.py BATTLE_KINDS).

values.name: Party
values.doc: The encounter record's parties.

values.name: Rematch
values.doc: The encounter record's parties, a rematch.

values.name: Unowned
values.doc: An unowned battler: species, level, held item.

values.name: Scripted
values.doc: A battle the game numbers itself (special set-ups).

values.name: Text
values.doc: A text (asset or inline).

values.name: Entry
values.doc: A list asset's text by index.

values.name: Number
values.doc: An operand in decimal.

values.name: Kind
values.doc: The name of a kind (an item, a species, ...) by id.

enums.name: NameKind
doc: C4: the engine's name kinds (a game's own follow from kFirstGameNameKind).

values.name: Item
values.doc: An item's name (the battle data's; with a count, the game's plural rule).

values.name: Species
values.doc: A species' name.

values.name: Move
values.doc: A move's name.

values.name: Nickname
values.doc: A party slot's nickname (party::role_get()).

values.name: Prepare
values.doc: Make the opponent a later battle fights.

values.name: Outcome
values.doc: The last battle's outcome.

values.name: RematchDue
values.doc: Whether the current side's rematch should be fought (`battle rematch due`).

values.name: RematchReady
values.doc: Whether the current side's rematch is registered (`battle rematch ready`).

values.name: Redraw
values.doc: Redraw the shown view.

values.name: Layout
values.doc: Show another map's terrain (0: its own).

values.name: Banner
values.doc: C12: show the shown map's name banner.

values.name: Arg
values.doc: Set an argument the next animations read.

values.name: Start
values.doc: Start an animation.

values.name: Wait
values.doc: Wait until it ends.

values.name: Detach
values.doc: Follow an invisible mover on the walker's cell.

values.name: Attach
values.doc: Follow the walker again.

values.name: Shake
values.doc: Shake the view.

values.name: Heal
values.doc: Every member's resources full, its status cleared.

values.name: Stash
values.doc: Keep a copy of the party.

values.name: Restore
values.doc: Put the stashed party back.

values.name: Count
values.doc: Count the members (hatched: eggs left out).

values.name: Find
values.doc: The first hatched member knowing a move.

values.name: Give
values.doc: C8: give a new creature (the party, else the boxes).

values.name: GiveEgg
values.doc: C8: give a new egg (`party give egg`).

values.name: Lead
values.doc: C13: the first hatched member's slot (0 when none).

values.name: CountAlive
values.doc: C13: count the hatched members with hit points, one slot left out or none (`party count alive [except <slot>]`).

values.name: HasType
values.doc: C13: whether a hatched member's species has a type (`party has type <type>`).

values.name: Room
values.doc: 1 when the bag takes n more of the item.

values.name: Pocket
values.doc: The item's pocket.

values.name: Show
values.doc: Show the box at its cells.

values.name: Update
values.doc: Show the value again.

values.name: Hide
values.doc: Hide the box.

values.name: Show
values.doc: Show a creature's picture.

values.name: Hide
values.doc: Hide it, waiting for its close.

values.name: Species
values.doc: Its species (the game's answer for an egg).

values.name: Egg
values.doc: 1 when it is an egg.

values.name: Moves
values.doc: How many moves it knows.

values.name: Friendship
values.doc: Its friendship (the layout's custom role friendship; 0 without one).

items.name: kOpConst8
items.doc: 1-byte unsigned constant.

items.name: kOpConst16
items.doc: 2-byte signed constant.

items.name: kOpConst32
items.doc: 4-byte signed constant.

items.name: kOpVar
items.doc: 2-byte variable ID.

items.name: kOpQuery
items.doc: Query byte and object byte.

items.name: kRouteNoWait
items.doc: Route: the script goes on at once.

items.name: kTransitionDefault
items.doc: Warp: the default transition.

items.name: kKeepFacing
items.doc: Warp / Place: facing kept.

items.name: kTextAsset
items.doc: 4-byte asset key of a text asset.

items.name: kTextInline
items.doc: 4-byte offset into Bank::text.

items.name: kNoVar
items.doc: Native without a result variable.

items.name: kNoCancel
items.doc: Choice: Back does nothing.

items.name: kObjectSelf
items.doc: Object operand: the context's own object.

items.name: kObjectPlayer
items.doc: Object operand: the walker.

items.name: kNoSelf
items.doc: Context::self: no object started the script.

items.name: kFacePlayer
items.doc: ObjectFace: towards the walker.

items.name: kFaceSelf
items.doc: ObjectFace: towards the context's own object.

items.name: kObjectCamera
items.doc: I4: object operand: the camera.

items.name: kObjectLast
items.doc: I4: object operand: the object the context last gave a route.

items.name: kObjectSelected
items.doc:
C10: object operand: the selected object, the context's own object or, when the context has none, the walker
(a reference game's "selected object", which its field input resets to the player every frame).

items.name: kFaceOppositePlayer
items.doc: C10: ObjectFace: the direction opposite the walker's facing (whatever the geometry; a reference game's way).

items.name: kWarpNoWait
items.doc: I4: Warp facing bit: the script goes on at once.

items.name: kWarpFacingMask
items.doc: I4: Warp facing bits without kWarpNoWait.

items.name: kLockSelf
items.doc: I4: Lock / Release: the context's object (and the others' movement).

items.name: kLockAll
items.doc: I4: Lock / Release: every object.

items.name: kMessageNoWait
items.doc: I4: MessageEx: the script goes on while it types.

items.name: kMessageInstant
items.doc: I4: MessageEx: typed at once.

items.name: kMessageAutoScroll
items.doc: I4: MessageEx: scrolls on without a button.

items.name: kFadeSwap
items.doc: I4: Fade flags: keep the palettes the scene changes meanwhile.

items.name: kObjectEncounter
items.doc: C1: object operand: the encounter record's current side's object.

items.name: kFaceEncounter
items.doc: C1: ObjectFace: towards the encounter record's current side's object.

items.name: kEncounterSideA
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set: side A.

items.name: kEncounterSideB
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set: side B.

items.name: kEncounterSideCurrent
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set: the current side.

items.name: kEncounterSideC
items.doc: C1b: Encounter Set / Select: side C (REF-14's third position; 2 is kEncounterSideCurrent).

items.name: kEncounterNoFlag
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set: no beaten flag.

items.name: kEncounterHasIntro
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set parts / Text: the intro text.

items.name: kEncounterHasDefeat
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set parts / Text: the defeat text.

items.name: kEncounterHasCannot
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set parts / Text: the cannot-battle text.

items.name: kEncounterHasAfter
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set parts: the after-script.

items.name: kEncounterHasThen
items.doc: C1: Encounter Set parts: a script to go on in at once (the return point stays after the Set).

items.name: kEncounterPair
items.doc: C1: Encounter mode bit: a pair battle (two battlers a side).

items.name: kEncounterRematch
items.doc: C1: Encounter mode bit: a rematch.

items.name: kEncounterNoMusic
items.doc: C1: Encounter mode bit: no encounter music.

items.name: kMenuBack
items.doc: C3: Menu flag: Back answers the cancel value (else Back does nothing).

items.name: kMenuFadeWait
items.doc: C3: Menu flag: input waits while the screen fades.

items.name: kMenuAt
items.doc: C3: Menu flag: x and y place it (its frame's top-left cell); else the port's place.

items.name: kMenuStyleDelay
items.doc: C3: Menu delay: the port's (its style's) frames before input.

items.name: kMaxStack
items.doc: VM call stack slots (the manifest's stack_depth is at most this).

items.name: kMaxNativeArgs
items.doc: Arguments per native call.

items.name: kMaxChoices
items.doc: Options of one Choice.

items.name: kMaxTriggers
items.doc: On-frame triggers armed at once (one map).

items.name: kMaxTriggerDeps
items.doc: Flags and variables one trigger reads.

items.name: kMaxMenuItems
items.doc: C3: options of one Menu (a list asset's first ones).

items.name: kFirstGameNameKind
items.doc: C4: the first game name kind (a scripts manifest's name_kinds, in order; NameKind's count).

items.name: kMaxGameNameKinds
items.doc: C4: name kinds a scripts manifest may declare.

items.name: kMaxCounters
items.doc: C5: counter boxes a scripts manifest may declare.

items.name: kGivenParty
items.doc: C8: party give's result: the creature joined the party.

items.name: kGivenBoxes
items.doc: C8: party give's result: the party was full, it went to the boxes.

items.name: kGivenNone
items.doc: C8: party give's result: nowhere had room (or it could not be built).

items.name: kNoMember
items.doc: C13: party count alive's slot when it leaves no member out (past every party slot).

items.name: kMaxStats
items.doc: C6: game statistics a scripts manifest may declare (a byte each).

doc: Opcodes (see the file comment for operands).
